name: Synn
message: 「If I borrow the power of the Rosary's guardian angel, I'll be fine」
Using the enhanced strength borrowed from the guardian angel, I could clear even a wall in a single bound.

name: Paqy
message: 「Ah, I get it. You ain't active as a Crusader right now, so the guardian angel ain't gonna respond either」

name: Paqy
message: 「Especially that one--quiet, stubborn, and totally inflexible」

name: Paqy
message: 「Seems like you've gotten a pretty good handle on the Demon King's power」

name: Synn
message: 「My heart was pounding when I jumped over...」

name: Paqy
message: 「Next is stamina. If you gotta transform every single time, you're gonna be in trouble in an emergency」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, this might actually work out for the best」

name: Synn
message: 「If I run into someone while transformed, they'll find out I'm the Demon King」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey, anyone out at this hour is guaranteed to be bad news if you *aren't* in Demon King form--」
I hurriedly stifled a gasp of astonishment before it could slip out.
Melilot was kneeling on the ground, stroking the dirt with her hand.

name: Paqy
message: 「It might be disguised to look like there's nothing there, y'know」

name: Paqy
message: 「Otherwise, she's just some airhead investigating something that isn't even there」
I ran away in a panic.
